name: Truth or Consequences
oracle_text: Secret council — Each player secretly votes for truth or consequences, then those votes are revealed. You draw cards equal to the number of truth votes. Then choose an opponent at random. Truth or Consequences deals 3 damage to that player for each consequences vote.
blocked_sentences: Secret council — Each player secretly votes for truth or consequences, then those votes are revealed.
You draw cards equal to the number of truth votes.
Then choose an opponent at random. Truth or Consequences deals 3 damage to that player for each consequences vote.

needs.what: a vote op (rule 701.38) in its Secret council form: every player simultaneously and hidden from the others chooses one of N named options (here 'truth' or 'consequences'), then all votes are revealed at once; the op binds the tally per option under an `as` (e.g. {binding: 'votes.truth'}, {binding: 'votes.consequences'}) so later effects can size a draw by the truth count and a damage amount of 3 times the consequences count
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode is one chooser picking modes, not every player casting a vote; for_each_player wrapping choose_mode cannot accumulate a count per chosen option, nothing makes the choices secret and simultaneous, and value_keys has no vote tally to size the draw or the damage. join_forces is the closest per-player decision but collects mana payments, not a choice
